Distances, angles and dihedrals along the Ag complex ensemble, and the coordination geometry of the
Ru complex.

**Files used** (from the repository):

* `files/ensemble.xyz` — 18 conformers of an Ag complex, 168 atoms
* `files/opt.out` — ORCA, r²SCAN-3c OptTS Freq (transition state), Ru complex C45H42F3IO2P2Ru

**1. One distance, one angle and one dihedral for every conformer.**

```bash
frog-internals files/ensemble.xyz -i 0 50 -i 50 0 83 -i 50 0 4 3
```

* Columns are ordered by type (`A`, `B`, `D`), not in the order of the `-i` options.
* The Ag–P50 distance stays between 2.528 and 2.657 Å and the P50–Ag0–P83 angle between 84.939° and
  107.097° (conformers 15 and 16 are the most open). The dihedral P50–Ag0–C4–N3 changes sign along the
  ensemble, from −72.307° (conformer 0) to +80.493° (conformer 14): this is the rotation used to sort
  the ensemble in `frog-sort`.

**2. Ru–ligand distances and the P–Ru–P bite angle of an ORCA output**, as CSV.

```bash
frog-internals files/opt.out -i 36 37 -i 36 38 -i 2 36 3 --format csv -q
```

```text
# Internal Coordinates
Structure,A P2-Ru36-P3 (°),B Ru36-C37 (Å),B Ru36-I38 (Å)
files/opt.out - Conf 0,85.23385025122903,1.8402686848354508,2.8164056177818213
```

CSV keeps full precision: Ru–C(O) 1.840 Å, Ru–I 2.816 Å and a P–Ru–P bite angle of 85.2°.
